title: explorerRelationsRecorded
responsibility: Resolve committed relationship IDs to catalog entities without searching source or inferring missing API usage.

inputs.name: recordedRelations.head
inputs.description: Selected revision with its committed registry and relationship collections.

inputs.name: recordedRelations.id
inputs.description: Stable identity of the module whose relationships are requested.

inputs.name: recordedRelations.entity
inputs.description: Catalog projection for each resolved registered module.

outputs.name: recordedRelations
outputs.description: Stored relationship groups, or undefined for a legacy revision without committed relationships.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Required relationship metadata is missing; asks the operator to run validation.
